title: What Happens After the Universe Ends?
summary: PBS Space Time explains Roger Penrose's conformal cyclic cosmology, in which the far future of our universe becomes the big bang of the next. It explores what could come after the universe ends.
why: HN recommends it as a clearer explanation of Penrose's cyclic cosmology than comment threads can give.

quote.text: It's explained in this PBS Space Time episode much better
